payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the baseline performance of models in comparison to other approaches, specifically mentioning the baseline models and their performance metrics.

claims.text: The baseline refers to the performance of the wFST models, which are purely monolingual and do not use data adaptation.
The baseline performance is measured using metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER) and Phoneme Error Rate (PER).
The LangID models outperform the baseline in WER 100, indicating that the baseline is lower than the performance of these models.
